title: Changelog #0003
summary: This week we added content, docs, and many examples for using Butter with popular tools like Langchain and Mastra
body_markdown:
Welcome to Butter’s third weekly changelog. This week we’ve been focused on content, documentation, and examples.


## New Examples


Examples section added to[Docs](https://docs.butter.dev/) , highlighting how to repoint popular AI tools through the Butter proxy endpoint. These include:


-


LLM Clients & Agent Frameworks


-


[Langchain / Langgraph](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/langchain)


-


[Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/vercel)


-


[Mastra](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/mastra)


-


[Pydantic AI](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/pydantic_ai)


-


[Crew AI](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/crew_ai)


-


[AI Suite](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/ai_suite)


-


[LiteLLM SDK](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/litellm#litellm-sdk)


-


Other HTTP proxies/gateways


-


[Helicone](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/helicone)


-


[LiteLLM](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/litellm#litellm-proxy)


-


[Martian](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/martian)


-


Specialized Tools


-


[Browser Use](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/browser_use) (custom fork)


-


[DSPy](https://docs.butter.dev/examples/dspy)


## Bugfixes & Improvements


-


Fixed race condition which caused thrashing in server’s disk cache


-


Added internal load tests, currently hitting ~120rps
